selection: Existing 120 train / 25 validation / 25 test; validation is unused; final epoch only

training.model: Random six-layer direct box detector, channels16/32/64/64/64/64; first four convolutions stride2; all kernels3/padding1/ReLU; final1x1 head15; no mask head
training.image: RGB FP32/255,128x128,bilinear antialias; training/metric target instances use nearest-exact
training.assignment: Instance ID order; center cell; highest shape IoU among three unused anchors, tie lower anchor; reject overflow instead of dropping targets
training.encoding: sigmoid cell-relative center x/y; log width/anchor-width and height/anchor-height; objectness logit bias=-2
training.loss: Sigmoid BCE times focal gamma2 plus 5*smoothL1(beta1) of positive box coordinates; both sums divided by max(positive count,1)
training.precision: FP32, no TF32, strict deterministic algorithms

evaluation.predictions: RGB-only model output; exp log-size clamped[-4,4], sigmoid inputs clamped[-80,80], clip xyxy to[0,128]; drop degenerate boxes; confidence>=0.01; stable descending score NMS with IoU>0.5 suppression; retain100
evaluation.ground_truth: tight exclusive xyxy for each resized instance ID, ordered by ID
evaluation.reference: Independent scalar decode/NMS plus pycocotools2.0.11 on saved native predictions
evaluation.partition: dataset batches1/4, preserving per-image model forward shape
evaluation.restore: After two committed batches; rebuild model/session; exact final report; complete reopen must not read data or invoke model

training_restore.require: Exact complete checkpoint and model file bytes after a fresh-process restore

qualification: Small independent detector task; not an official benchmark split or a complete detection recipe/support matrix
